meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Money supply (M3) every fortnight since 2001: currency with the public, demand and time deposits with banks, and where the money comes from (bank credit to government and to the commercial sector, foreign exchange assets)
meta.note: RBI DBIE Data Query tables MSC_F (money stock components) and MSS_F (sources), ₹ lakh crore. M1 is derived as currency with the public plus demand deposits plus other deposits with the RBI. Series marked 'including the HDFC merger' are RBI's figures from July 2023 that count HDFC Ltd's balance sheet inside the banking system; the plain series exclude it until they stop (time deposits and M3 in June 2025). The two are different rulers and are never joined.
